items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And now and then Sharky and Emma get up there. Come on, watch. Sit on the bandstand. I go up there and sit down and listen at him play a few numbers.

ctx.x: to talk about a beautiful place in town.

People informal. And here Sharky and this man in tux, man. Uh-huh. And just nothing but gambling tables. Long ball, gambling table. And now they'd be up at the ball. They'd be drinking a while. Now and then they played music. I never saw nobody on the ballroom floor, but the music was to draw the people, I guess, see. And now and then Sharky and Emma get up there. Come on, watch.
